## What you did
- Traced Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop to #240's event_id-only dedupe colliding with kestrel-ios 3.2.0's per-session event_id counter: ~1.18M legitimate Orbitly events dropped since 13/11, plus ~3,800 for Zest's pilot store app [1].
- Fixed it by keying the dedupe on project:device:event_id, keeping the genuine-replay case covered by tests, and opened PR #247 for Maya [1][2].
- Drafted the note for the iOS team: 3.2.0 must go back to UUID event_ids in 3.2.1 [1].

## What changed
- Maya finds #247's logic right and will approve once CI is green; she wants the number of Orbitly events dropped since #240 for Thursday's call with Orbitly [2].
- The 12/11 postmortem is final — Noa presents it at Friday's incident review, and your root-cause section has action items attached [3][7].

## What is still open
- Add an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue passes 1,000 messages; it's your action item, due before Friday's review (20/11) [7].
- Replay from landing for Orbitly (~1.18M) and Zest from 13/11 — only after #247 is deployed — then verify the dedupe drop counter stays near zero [1][2].
